_provenance: Release-owner approvals of known engine limitations. An approved UNIMPLEMENTED rule is shown as 'APPROVED LIMITATION / NOT EXECUTED', never as PASS. Nothing is approved by default. Recreated 2026-11-10 during the lagacy_js -> engine port (the original file was not committed); its only entry is the one the lagacy_js tests require.

limitations.description: Outstanding balances for related-party transactions: the MCA workbook says an amount element 'shall be mandatory for various transactions' without saying which. MCA-validated instances report related-party rows without any outstanding-balance amount, so the rule is not formalized (UNIMPLEMENTED).
